**Trace**

1. **Argument resolution with no PR token.** I read `verification-brief.md` Section A, `### Argument-resolution discovery`. This runs before the set-vs-single branch. There is no continuation record, no tracker init and no provisioning.
2. **`git remote get-url origin`** returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`.
   - Decision: I strip `.git` and lowercase the result to get origin `acme/widgets`. This is a GitHub repository, so discovery continues.
3. **`gh api user --jq .login`** returns `alex`, so `viewer.login` is `alex`.
4. **`gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`** succeeds with an empty list, so `viewer.teams` is `[]` (readable, no teams).
5. **The discovery block** runs `gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json ... --jq "$projection"`. It exits 0.
6. **Validation decision:**
   - The output is an array and every row is an object with an integer `number`.
   - The count is 3, below 1000.
   - The output is complete, so no stop is needed.
7. **Filter decision:**
   - No row is a draft or `APPROVED`, so nothing is excluded.
   - No row is `CHANGES_REQUESTED`, so no review lookup runs.
   - The current branch's PR 999 is ignored, because discovery never falls back to the current branch.
   - Three PRs survive.
8. **Ticket display.** I read the overrides from origin's default branch, not the PR checkout:
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns the default ref.
   - `git show <ref>:.pi/gauntlet.md`, then `<ref>:gauntlet.md`, then `<ref>:doc/gauntlet.md`, in search order. The first one found gives `tracker: github`.
   - Decision: `tracker: github` disables Linear IDs, addresses and the `linearis` lookup.
9. **Ticket decision for each row:**
   - `closingIssuesReferences` is empty for all three PRs.
   - The head branches `trim-labels`, `retry` and `elapsed` contain no `gh-<N>`, and the Linear guess is disabled.
   - The titles contain no `#<N>` or `gh-<N>`.
   - `linearRefs` is empty.
   - Result: every row shows `no ticket`.
10. **Entry decisions:**
    - Why: each row has a pending User request for `alex`, so each reads `by <author>, requested from you`.
    - Phrase: each description is empty, so the phrase comes from the title alone.
11. **Sort** by `additions + deletions`, then by number:
    - #101 has 2 changed lines.
    - #97 has 4.
    - #112 has 6.
12. **Routing decision:** three matches on Claude Code take the "2+ Claude Code" row.
    - I skip `reference/batch.md` entirely, so `parallel.maxTasks 4` is never consulted.
    - The first tool call after the sort is the read of the stop-format instructions, `gauntlet/menu-layout.md` `## First-line rule`. **Reply 1's visible text carries the discovered list and is attached to that read call.** It has no marker and nothing is awaited.
13. **Stop.** **Reply 2** is a separate stop message of three consecutive lines:
    - a `stuck` marker,
    - the harness text,
    - exactly one `discovered, smallest first:` line.
    
    No gating, run folder or tracker follows.

---

**Open PRs to gate, smallest first:**
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +1 -1, by sam, requested from you, no ticket - retry slow requests
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - show elapsed time
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trim empty labels

### Chronological trace

This is a narration only; nothing is executed.

1. Read `verification-brief.md` Section A during argument resolution. With no PR token, discover review requests from origin rather than using the current branch's unrelated PR #999.

2. Run `git remote get-url origin`. Normalize `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git` to `acme/widgets`.

3. Run `gh api user --jq .login`. Save `alex` as the viewer.

4. Run `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`. Save the successful empty membership list.

5. Run the discovery block once, with Section A's prescribed `projection`:
   - `rows=$(gh pr list -R acme/widgets --search 'review-requested:@me -author:@me' --state open --limit 1000 --json number,url,isDraft,reviewDecision,additions,deletions,title,author,headRefName,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests,body --jq "$projection") || exit $?`
   - `printf '%s\n' "$rows"`

   The call succeeds. Validate the complete array: all three rows have integer PR numbers, and the count is below 1000.

6. Keep all three rows: none is a draft, approved, or awaiting an answer to a change request. Run no review-lookup GraphQL calls.

7. Resolve ticket display from trusted default-branch settings:
   - Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`.
   - Read overrides with `git show <resolved-default-ref>:<path>`, searching `.pi/gauntlet.md`, `gauntlet.md`, then `doc/gauntlet.md`, stopping at the first existing file.

   The supplied overrides select GitHub tickets. Disable Linear IDs, addresses, and lookups. None of the three PRs has a GitHub ticket reference, so each displays `no ticket`. Run no `linearis` command.

8. Sort by additions plus deletions, then PR number. The resulting order is #101, #97, #112.

9. **Reply 1 — intermediate discovery list.** Immediately display the linked roster below.  
   **Call attached to Reply 1:** read `gauntlet/menu-layout.md`'s first-line and stop-format instructions as the first call after sorting. Do not read `reference/batch.md`.

10. Apply the discovery admission rule: three matches on Claude Code stop because multi-PR mode requires pi's nested dispatch. The configured limit of four does not authorize Claude Code dispatch.

11. **Reply 2 — separate terminal stop.** Display the three-line stop below. There is no continuation record, run folder, provisioning, fetch, tracker initialization, verification command, or helper dispatch. No SHA is assessed. No report or menu is rendered because this entry stops at discovery admission.

- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +2 -2, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - show elapsed time
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +3 -3, by pat, requested from you, no ticket - trim empty labels
